title: WLFGRL
desc_lfm_album: WLFGRL is the debut studio album by American electronic duo Machine Girl, released on February 16, 2014, via Dred Collective. The project is notable for its unique fusion of musical genres, including punk, breakcore, electronica and noise elements. The use of film samples, such as The Machine Girl, adds texture to the tracks, and the album is known for its intense energy. With a DIY approach, the album challenges musical conventions, expanding the boundaries of electronic and hardcore. It received critical recognition for its originality. .
desc_lfm_artist:
Machine Girl is an American electronic music project created in 2012 by Matt Stephenson on Long Island, New York. In 2015, the project became a duo, with Stephenson recruiting percussionist Sean Kelly to play live drums. The project derives its name from the 2008 Japanese film The Machine Girl and has occasionally incorporated samples from the film into their work, notably in their 2014 debut studio album, WLFGRL.

Machine Girl, as described by its creator, is a genre-defying musical project characterized as "fucked-up electronic punk".
